title: Assam flood death toll rises to 94; situation remains grim
summary: The death toll from floods in Assam has risen to 94, with the situation remaining grim. The government said that 94 people have died so far due to the floods. The opposition alleged that the government's response to the crisis was slow. Police claimed that they were doing their best to rescue those stranded by the floods. The government ordered a long-term drainage masterplan for Guwahati. Over 1.6 lakh people are affected across 14 districts.
summary_points: The death toll from floods in Assam has risen to 94
Over 1.6 lakh people are affected across 14 districts
The government ordered a long-term drainage masterplan for Guwahati
